drafted_from: tool:answer-the-search-page-route's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Answer the page's one search (GET /work/api/search) over every list, record and file name I keep", with {"path":"/search","method":"GET","query":{"q":"merlinfalcon"},"body":{},"browser":{}, "records": [...], "files": {...}} (the records and files read from your own store). It runs tool:answer-the-search-page-route and answers {"status":200,"body":{"question":"merlinfalcon","terms":["merlinfalcon"],"results":[...],"unavailable":[],"pending":[]}}; each result has found_in, said, score and address.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and the rows and file names of yours it is given, and keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Answer the page's one search (GET /work/api/search) over every list, record and file name I keep", and give it path (The route after /work/api (/search)); method.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:answer-the-search-page-route and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The page's GET /work/api/search, run by the engine for the page's account (workshop-routes): the request's { path, method, query } in, { status, body } out, where body is the one search's answer (searchEverything) for query q, with places, sources and matches as comma lists and limit (1..200) as old src/search.mjs searchOptions read them.
4. It is given only rows of every kind and the names of the person's files (reads).

worked_examples.title: Answer the search page route on its own sample
worked_examples.ask: Answer the page's one search (GET /work/api/search) over every list, record and file name I keep
worked_examples.given: The input {"path":"/search","method":"GET","query":{"q":"merlinfalcon","sources":"trillion"},"body":{},"browser":{}}, with 4 example rows (sample-contacts, sample-invoices, sample-places) already kept.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered status 200 with body {question, terms, results, unavailable, pending}: the records (found_in written) and the file names (found_in name) that hold the word, each with its said and its address (the person's own record by id and kind, or a file by path).
